book.name: Sarenta halomang-halomang
book.title: Sarenta Halomang-Halomang Lahatala Ana por-alolang bot burang ening

content: Yakob iimal bihit Betel mi ila

Angmuse Lahatala Ana Yakob at mateng hula, “Aava veng haraka, senge Betel mi ila, bot angumi mihi. Naing anga Lahatala ba aana tura bihit aava metma eekaku Esau eahalang, senge Na Nava metma eetubing angu. Angu ebele aana ila angmomi se, aana malekang sadaka edoru angu ening metma maNenang.”

Angmuse Yakob ana ehava omi enehe ang naung emangpi iat mateng hula, “Aaneda ba ue iihahama mi ang naung iini malekang metma iiahalang, bot iidiri-iiababahi angu ening ahamulang, senge iipakiang ang naung telul. Mahe pi tava vengharaka, senge pi Betel mi ila angmomi mihi. Tura na susa omimi angu, Lahatala Ana noangmoling iila. Base ila angumi senge sadaka edoru angu na ening metma Lahatala Enang. Aulang senge pi Lahatala angu ba Aing somba.”
Angmuse ing emangpi iaaneda ba ing veng ang naung, bot iaantil
ba iaver mi ang naung emangpi metma Yakob enang. Angmuse na ang naung emangpi Yakob ana metma Sikem aabang abung angmi, te eele nu angu iivang taloul.

Sengmuse ing emangpi tahit lamal. Uanguveng ini lamal angu, Lahatala Ana jonga-baroti metma bendar-bendar ba ing venggoleng jehi angu enehe ang naung iomimi, angu ebele ini bae baranit jasi ening metma iadana niang.
Base Yakob bot enehe ang naung ing emangpi lamal aaung-hamat sampe ila Kanaan por taang, Betel (ba tura ene, Lus) angu mi.

Ila angumi muse, Yakob ana var ba metma sadaka edoru angu ening, sengmuse ana mana angu ene maveng, ene El Betel, (evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌBetel eLahatalaꞌ). Se uanguveng Yakob ana bihit ava metma ekaku eahalang angu, Lahatala Ana angumi Ava metma Yakob etubing angu ebele.

Betel aabang abung angu, te eele nu angu nehe ene maveng hula, Alon Bakut. Evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌte eele bau-pei emanaꞌ. Ene aulang, se Ribka iva ababaning, ene Debora angu, aamina muse, nehe aing metma te angu iivang taloul angu ebele.
Uanguveng Yakob ana Padan Aram mi bale hoa muse, Lahatala ana bot Ava metma etubing, bot Ana Eaaung-Ehama angu metma maenang.
Lahatala Ana Yakob at hubait hula, “Mulai vede angase, eene bae Yakob niang iila. Aarunge Na eene maveng, eene Israel.

Naing anga, Lahatala ba Mikavasa angu. Base, aana tabaning-taheli, senge ooal-iidat angu ening toang-rae! Eetabaning angu eningse metma bangsa-bangsa ening, bot raja-raja ang naung eningse aana malekang vengajai.
Aabang anga Na metma iidat boma Abraham enang, bot metma iimang Isak enang iila, angase Na metma maeenang, bot metma eetabaning ang naung di inang.

Lahatala Ana Yakob at hubait aulang sengmuse, Ana mida Yakob eahalang. Angmuse Yakob ana var ohit metma tugu ening, mana angu mi atahing, aulange metma Lahatala Epalai angu etanda ening. Yakob ana anggor ejar, bot iipil metma tugu angu vengbokong, sengmuse ana Lahatala Aing somba.
Mana ba Lahatala Ana mi Yakob at hubai angu, Yakob ana ene maveng hula, Betel.
Benyamin vengajai sengmuse Rahel ana aamina
Seng angmuse Yakob iimal ini tahil lamal Betel eahalang. Uanguveng ini lamal ila Efrata (benangba Betlehem) angu abung muse, Rahel ejol ajai mi tila. Aarunge ana ajai angu etatabit susa.
Rahel ana jedung vaal angu veng umi etatabit susa sehi se, aabiangvala ana at mateng hula, “Ekang uuangmari ekang! Oomi ening aanamang, anga di vaal mehal ba aana vengajai!”

Uanguveng Rahel ana hula eeng abang muse, ana vaal angu ene maveng, ene Ben-Oni, (evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌvaal ba nesusa-lala omimi hoaꞌ). Seng angmuse Rahel ana aamina. Aarunge Yakob ana vaal angu ene maveng, ene Benyamin, (evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌvaal atang teneꞌ).
Angmuse ini Rahel aing metma via ba Efrata aabang adang ila angu, eadil angmi taloul, (angase aabang angu ini ene maveng hula Betlehem).
Yakob ana var nu metma tugu ening, Rahel edaang angu taang bakung atahing. Rahel edaang evar tugu angu, angase jedung ue.
Yakob oal ang naung
Seng angmuse Yakob
iimal ini bot iava asorong ila mana nu ene Migdal-Eder angu mi iteeng ening.
Uanguveng Yakob iimal ini aabang angu mi mihi sehi se, Ruben ana imang ejangu gariang, Bilha angu, at tia. Angmuse Yakob ana na angu vengmee. Yakob oal mehal angu inang arinu belta aalu.
Lea oal naung benangba; Ruben (Yakob oal mutu), Simon, Lewi, Yahuda, Isaskar, bot Sebulon.
Rahel oal naung benangba; Yusup, bot Benyamin.
Rahel emalea Bilha angu oal naung benangba; Dan, bot Naftali.
Lea emalea Silpa angu oal naung benangba; Gad, bot Aser. Vaal ang naung ing emangpi Padan Aram mi ing vengajai.
Yakob imang Isak aamina
Angmuse Yakob ana ila Mamre ba Kiryat-Arba aabang abung angu, mi imang Isak euuling, (aabang ba angase, ene Hebron) angu. Tura idat boma Abraham di angumi mihi.
Isak ana aabetat euumur mitung 180 sengmuse, ana aamina. Angmuse oal Esau, bot Yakob oleve aing taloul.

footnotes.text: Tura angu, iaaneda ang naung egambar angu ue iaantil ang naung mi.
Israel angu evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌLahatala at taing-gomolꞌ.
Angami angu, Ibrani ehur mi hurak hula, ꞌIsraelꞌ. Israel, bot Yakob angu, nehe nu ene.
